status: Editorial starting points; adapt to each brief, not fixed templates
rules: Give each platform/channel combination a distinct visual and editorial identity.
Never restyle an unrelated channel template merely by changing text, colors or assets.
Choose pacing, layouts, demonstrations, typography, transitions, sound and covers for the subject.
Reuse technical modules, not entire editorial treatments across unrelated channels.
Keep shared Sao Viet branding and vary concepts within each channel.
Latest user preference 2026-10-20: domain-specific, lively, easy-to-understand visual explanations; narration-led edits without long empty pauses.

autocad.direction: Teach AutoCAD with precise, lively drawing demonstrations and concrete geometric examples
autocad.visuals: CAD model-space grid, crosshair, selected geometry, command prompts, dimension annotations, before/after overlays; reveal construction steps as narrated
autocad.pacing: Show the finished geometric result first, then demonstrate command, parameter, object selection and result with short purposeful pauses
autocad.avoid: Static text-card sequences, reusing accounting or Office layouts, misleading simulation presented as an actual software capture, decorative motion obscuring geometry

tin-hoc-van-phong.visuals: Readable spreadsheets/documents, selected cells, cursor-led demonstrations, before/after results
tin-hoc-van-phong.pacing: Short instructions with enough time to read and repeat the operation
tin-hoc-van-phong.avoid: Decorative motion that obscures formulas or instructions

ke-toan.visuals: Accounting scenarios, sales receipts, expense allocation, transaction flows and animated calculation steps. Motion must explain where figures come from; avoid static text-card sequences.
ke-toan.pacing: Continuous clear narration, short purposeful pauses, scene duration measured from actual speech; reveal figures when mentioned.
ke-toan.avoid: Invented regulations, unsupported tax claims, excessive playful effects

photoshop.visuals: Before/after reveals, crops, layers, masks, color transformations and image details
photoshop.pacing: Result-led hook followed by selected stages of the creative process
photoshop.avoid: Spreadsheet-style layouts or text-heavy explanations replacing the visual transformation

ky-thuat.direction: Concrete mechanisms, structure and hands-on process
ky-thuat.visuals: Equipment/detail shots, technical drawings or diagrams when relevant, annotations, dimensions and step-by-step assembly/operation
ky-thuat.pacing: Overview, relevant detail, action or mechanism, result; let technical actions remain legible
ky-thuat.avoid: Office-course spreadsheet templates, invented specifications or irrelevant blueprint decoration

platforms.tiktok: Immediate practical hook, vertical framing, close demonstrations, short captions, controlled changes of pace and a concise CTA
platforms.facebook: Adapt to Reels or feed placement; accessible context, community/course relevance and a suitable invitation to interact
platforms.youtube: Distinguish Shorts from regular video; use coherent explanation, orientation and topic progression appropriate to the selected format
